It will cost $4,000 per curriculum for the parenting program. This includes the new videos,
worksheets, baby models, and materials.  It will be $8,000 for a new English and Spanish
parenting curriculum to offer to clients.

enough in supply to meet the demand.

be donated to the center. This will allow the center to stock up so that the demand is met with an
adequate supply.
